verdict.rationale: Unity ships Sentis, an official package (com.unity.ai.inference) that is a neural network inference library. It imports trained models and runs them in real time on the target device's compute resources, and the package is confirmed in Unity's UPM registry. That directly matches an official on-device inference runtime for games. missing for 10: details on supported model formats, backends and platform coverage, and independent hands-on corroboration of in-game inference performance.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can run ML models inside the game — an official inference runtime for on-device model execution

citations.quote: Sentis is a neural network inference library for Unity. It lets you import trained neural network models into Unity and run them in real-time with your target device's compute resources
packages.unity.com/com.unity.ai.inference resolves Sentis, 'a neural network inference library' for on-device ML in games
